title: Fulminant Myocarditis Following Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Therapy: A Case Report
abstract: Acute heart failure in a melanoma patient on nivolumab.
clinical_findings: Severe biventricular failure with troponin elevation.
timeline: Day 1: Nivolumab infusion; Day 14: Dyspnea and shock; Day 15: Biopsy confirmation; Day 28: Recovery.
diagnostic_assessment: Cardiac MRI and endomyocardial biopsy showing lymphocytic infiltration.
therapeutic_intervention: High-dose intravenous methylprednisolone 1000 mg daily and abatacept.
informed_consent: Written informed consent obtained from patient.

title: Refractory Autoimmune Encephalitis with Extreme Delta Brush: A Case Report
abstract: Anti-NMDAR encephalitis responsive to second-line rituximab.
timeline: Day 1: Behavioral changes; Day 7: LP positive; Day 21: Full recovery.
diagnostic_assessment: CSF GluN1 IgG antibody positivity and EEG extreme delta brush.
informed_consent: Written informed consent obtained from guardian.

title: Post-Transplant Lymphoproliferative Disorder Presenting as Gastric Ulcer: A Case Report
abstract: Rare gastric PTLD in a renal transplant recipient.
clinical_findings: Epigastric pain melena and weight loss.
timeline: Day 1: Melena; Day 3: Endoscopy biopsy; Day 10: Rituximab started; Day 90: Complete remission.
diagnostic_assessment: EGD biopsy demonstrating EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
therapeutic_intervention: Reduction of tacrolimus and 4 weekly cycles of rituximab.
informed_consent: Written informed consent obtained from patient.
